goal.insight: Show the complete data pipeline from five distinct source categories through ingestion, Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion layers, to BI and ML consumption endpoints
Visually emphasize the cross-cutting data governance, access control, and lineage tracking mechanisms that span across all pipeline stages
Highlight the relative data volume flowing from each source category through the pipeline, making high-throughput paths visually prominent
Distinguish the three medallion layers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) by showing the nature and count of transformations applied at each stage
Emphasize how Gold-layer datasets fan out to multiple consumption endpoints including dashboards, ML models, and API services
